name: scan-for-xss
description: Scans frontend and backend code for cross-site scripting risks including reflected XSS, stored XSS, DOM XSS, unsafe HTML sinks, unsafe template rendering, missing output encoding, sanitizer misuse, unsafe markdown rendering, and weak Content Security Policy.
instructions:
# scan-for-xss

Scans code and templates for reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS risks.

## Orchestration

1. Load `references/rules.yaml` to get the active `XSS-` rule set.
2. Load `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` and use the mapped OWASP cheat sheets to support remediation guidance and references.
3. Identify target evidence from source code, configuration, tests, API specs, IaC, CI/CD, runtime manifests, and documentation relevant to the request.
4. Evaluate each rule using its `match_strategy`, preserving file path, line, snippet, control context, and confidence.
5. Mark each rule `Pass`, `Fail`, `Partial`, `Unknown`, or `Not Applicable` based on available evidence.
6. Prioritize findings by severity, exploitability, exposed surface, and whether a concrete remediation is available.
7. Render the final report using `references/report-template.md`.

## Usage

Scan the current repository:

```text
/scan-for-xss
```

Scan a specific path:

```text
/scan-for-xss src/ services/ docs/
```

## OWASP Cheat Sheets

Use the shared mapping in `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` for authoritative OWASP Cheat Sheet Series references that match this skill. Include the relevant cheat sheet links in the report when they directly support a finding or remediation.

## Review Guidance

Prioritize user-controlled data flowing into HTML, JavaScript, URL, CSS, markdown, rich text, and template sinks.

rules.name: Detect user input reaching innerHTML-like sinks
rules.description: Identify untrusted data assigned to innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, or equivalent sinks.
rules.remediation: Use safe DOM APIs, framework escaping, or vetted sanitization with strict policies.

rules.name: Detect disabled template escaping
rules.description: Identify raw/unescaped template output such as triple braces or safe filters on user data.
rules.remediation: Use contextual output encoding and avoid marking untrusted data as safe.

rules.name: Detect reflected request data in responses
rules.description: Identify request parameters rendered into HTML without output encoding.
rules.remediation: Apply contextual output encoding and validation.

rules.name: Detect stored untrusted content rendered unsafely
rules.description: Identify database or CMS content rendered into HTML/JS without sanitization or encoding.
rules.remediation: Sanitize on write where appropriate and encode on output.

rules.name: Detect URL/hash/location data reaching DOM sinks
rules.description: Identify location, hash, search, postMessage, or storage data reaching DOM sinks.
rules.remediation: Validate sources and use safe sinks such as textContent.

rules.name: Detect untrusted data in JavaScript contexts
rules.description: Identify interpolation into inline scripts, event handlers, or JavaScript URLs.
rules.remediation: Avoid inline scripts and use JavaScript string encoding or data attributes safely.

rules.name: Detect unsafe URL construction
rules.description: Identify untrusted values placed in href/src/action without scheme allowlisting.
rules.remediation: Allowlist http/https or expected schemes and encode attributes.

rules.name: Detect unsafe sanitizer configuration
rules.description: Identify sanitizers allowing scripts, event handlers, dangerous URLs, or custom HTML unsafely.
rules.remediation: Use maintained sanitizers with restrictive configuration and tests.

rules.name: Detect unsafe markdown rendering
rules.description: Identify markdown rendered with raw HTML enabled or unsafe plugins.
rules.remediation: Disable raw HTML or sanitize rendered output.

rules.name: Detect missing CSP for XSS mitigation
rules.description: Identify apps with XSS-exposed surfaces and no meaningful CSP.
rules.remediation: Add restrictive CSP without unsafe-inline for scripts where possible.

rules.name: Detect unsafe postMessage handling
rules.description: Identify message handlers without origin validation or with HTML sinks.
rules.remediation: Validate origin/schema and avoid dangerous sinks.

rules.name: Detect missing XSS regression tests
rules.description: Identify critical rendering paths without tests for escaping and sanitization.
rules.remediation: Add tests for encoded output and blocked malicious payloads.
